crossRefs.note: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Hagar
people.line: Sarah's Egyptian maidservant; mother of Ishmael.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Son of Abraham and Hagar; father of Arab tribes.

translations.web: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.
translations.bsb: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to him.
translations.kjv: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
translations.asv: And Abram was fourscore and six years old, when Hagar bare Ishmael to Abram.
